These instruments can detect changes in length smaller than one-ten-thousandth the diameter of a proton.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's an impressive level of precision. So, these detectors are essentially acting like incredibly sensitive ears for the universe?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
